row.evidence: Hex's Enterprise page lists 'SSO and SCIM' and 'SCIM Directory sync from Okta, Active Directory, and Google', and the Directory Sync docs say it is 'Available on the Enterprise plan'.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM directory sync is Enterprise-only (Custom / Contact us). Prices unchanged: Professional $36 and Team $75 per editor/mo (the pricing page does not say whether these are annual or monthly figures). SSO is OIDC only (SAML not supported) and is also Enterprise-only. Setup runs through a hosted portal where the admin picks a directory provider; Hex does not publish a SCIM base URL, attribute list or deprovisioning behaviour, and no Hex app was found in the Okta or Entra catalogues. Okta, Entra and Google are recorded as via_generic because Hex names them as directory sources without a catalogue app. The SCIM plan is not on the pricing page itself (only on the Enterprise page and docs), so confidence is medium. The REST Admin API (users, groups, deactivate) is on Team and Enterprise, one tier above the Professional team plan; audit logs are Enterprise-only and viewed or streamed through WorkOS.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Audit logs are Enterprise-only, viewed in WorkOS or streamed to a SIEM; no Hex audit-log REST endpoint is documented.

roles.how: Map a directory group to the Hex Admin role and another to Editor; users in neither group become Viewers. Role syncing can be disabled to manage roles in Hex.

limitations.text: Directory-synced groups cannot be edited in Hex; membership must be managed in the directory provider.
With Okta, group membership changes need a manual 'Push now' or they may not propagate fully.
Single-tenant workspaces must contact Hex support to configure directory sync.
Setup goes through a hosted portal where the admin selects a directory provider; Hex does not publish SCIM endpoints, attributes or deprovisioning behaviour.

endpoints.purpose: List all users in the workspace

audit_log_api.notes: Audit logs are viewed in WorkOS (CSV export) or streamed to S3, Datadog, Splunk or GCS; no REST endpoint documented.

rate_limits.text: 60 API requests per user per minute; ListUsers and DeactivateUser are limited to 30 requests per minute.

limitations.text: No documented endpoint to create or invite users or change a user's role.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'hex' returns Hexnode, Crimson Hexagon and Paychex apps only.

fallbacks.other_sync: Hosted directory-sync portal (Okta, Rippling, Google, Azure and more)
